text:
Your biggest enemy isn't failure. It's the wrong people.

Every great achiever I've seen had one specific person. Presence alone made them work better. A wife. A partner. A secretary.

One man said his secretary was there for most of his best ideas. Her energy raised the room.

You've been blaming yourself. Stop.

Deliberately put yourself around people who lift you. One person. Not a team. Just one who makes you think faster, work deeper.

Who you're standing next to decides who you become.
caption:
Your mindset matters, but your circle matters more. The quality of people around you directly determines the quality of work you produce.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #mindset #success #relationships #mentalstrength
